changes.key: Cancel anytime in Settings before day %lld.
changes.source: Cancel anytime in Settings before day %lld.
changes.old: Bis Tag %lld jederzeit in den Einstellungen kündbar.
changes.new: Vor Tag %lld jederzeit in den Einstellungen kündbar.
changes.reason: Bis Tag expresses an until/up-to boundary and does not preserve the source’s exclusive before-day deadline. Replace only Bis with Vor.
changes.source_context: PaywallView.swift:1174–1184 uses selectedTrialDays (fallback 14) and only shows the note with the trial timeline when reminders are blocked; the spoken timeline uses the same string at line 1319.
changes.proposed_back_translation: Cancelable at any time in Settings before day %lld.

changes.key: Cancel anytime in Settings before day %lld.
changes.source: Cancel anytime in Settings before day %lld.
changes.old: Atšaukite bet kada nustatymuose prieš %lld d.
changes.new: Atšaukite bet kada nustatymuose prieš prasidedant %lld dienai.
changes.reason: The abbreviation in prieš %lld d. permits a duration/ago reading rather than a numbered trial day. The replacement says before day %lld begins, preserving the exclusive boundary without a fixed numeral-dependent ordinal suffix.
changes.source_context: PaywallView.swift:1174–1184 uses selectedTrialDays (fallback 14) and only shows the note with the trial timeline when reminders are blocked; the spoken timeline uses the same string at line 1319.
changes.proposed_back_translation: Cancel at any time in settings before day %lld begins.
